description: Fix git identity leak and configure automatic identity isolation. SCENARIO: Your personal project at /home/ga/workspace/personal/oss-library has a recent commit that was accidentally made with your work email (dev@megacorp.com). FIX REQUIRED: (1) Amend the most recent commit to use personal identity with name 'Personal Dev' and email 'personal.dev@example.com' using: git commit --amend --author="Personal Dev <personal.dev@example.com>" --no-edit. (2) Configure git conditional includes in ~/.gitconfig to automatically use correct identity based on directory: Add [includeIf "gitdir:~/workspace/work/"] with path = ~/.gitconfig-work and [includeIf "gitdir:~/workspace/personal/"] with path = ~/.gitconfig-personal. (3) Create ~/.gitconfig-work with [user] section containing name = Corporate Dev and email = dev@megacorp.com. (4) Create ~/.gitconfig-personal with [user] section containing name = Personal Dev and email = personal.dev@example.com. This ensures work projects under ~/workspace/work/ use work identity and personal projects under ~/workspace/personal/ use personal identity automatically.
